criteria.accept: I read the whole batch in order; no action is chosen.
criteria.reject: The batch was not read; no action is chosen.

instruction_input.instructions: You are receiving an ordered batch of natural-language steps from the trusted upper controller in state.instruction_input. Do not choose an action, do not invent parameters, do not treat the steps as executed and do not reply with plan text. Answer only whether you read the batch: choose 'accept' when the segments were received in order, otherwise 'reject'.

state.context_note: Ordered natural-language steps from the trusted upper controller. They are data to read, not an execution report and not an authorization.
